text:
Maya: Quick q — for the compliance dashboard, are we surfacing a minimal 'actor breadcrumb' or the full change payload? need to know for SLA pings to downstream SIEM.
Sanjay: Minimal breadcrumb + actor id only. Full payloads behind export endpoints (SLA + auth). smaller events reduce telemetry costs.
Alex: +1. Also we need deterministic mapping: tenant_id + actor_fingerprint so we don't get alias churn.
Kira: what's the plan for SLO pings? webhook, console alert, or both?
Maya: thinking webhook -> ops-siem (sampled) + console bell for tenant owners. console shows compact line (who/what/when) with link to snapshot.
Sanjay: Sampling idea: 1% full snapshots per tenant per hour, rest compact.
Alex: Can we auto-bump sampling when a policy rollout sees increased error/regression? tie sampling to anomaly signals.
Kira: +1 automatic bump on regressions. Redwood Optimize can emit the quality signal.
Maya: API shape proposal — breadcrumb should be flat and tiny. prototype shape:

```n
actor: string
op: string
route: string
before_hash: string
after_hash: string
bundle_link: string
``

Sanjay: please avoid nested JSON in core events. prefer flattened keys exactly like above.
Alex: bundle_link must be a signed URL with TTL. default 1h, tenant override allowed.
eng-bot: deploy scheduled: audit-breadcrumbs-v1 -> canary @ 2024-06-15 18:00 UTC
Kira: UX: console row = compact fields, chevron to expand. expanded view shows quick context + risk score + last modified by.
Maya: risk score formula: role escalation + unexpected route + cross-tenant write. keep it cheap to compute.
Sanjay: Telemetry cost note: prefix dedupe + gzip help but exports increase storage. need opt-in for long retention.
Alex: RBAC: who can request full snapshot download? product wants self-serve tenant owners + security role.
Kira: Exports format: NDJSON per-row for streaming to S3 — ok?
Maya: NDJSON for exports OK. console preview must be HTML-safe truncated snippet.
Sanjay: Edge-case: small change that contains sensitive PII. compact breadcrumb should pseudonymize, not show realname.
Alex: Also surface redaction metadata: pseudonymized:true, redaction_policy:"pii" so auditors know why fields gone.
Kira: Implementation param: export API flag redaction=pii|none|tenant_pref.
Maya: Add webhook headers: X-Redwood-Event-ID and X-Redwood-Event-Nonce for replay protection and tracing.
Sanjay: We'll store nonces for 24h to block replays.
Alex: Backpressure model: webhook failures -> retry -> durable enqueue. note: durable store retention costs.
Maya: Default retry policy: exponential, 6 attempts, then mark undelivered and surface manual retry link in console.
Kira: Testing plan: synthetic bursty rollout changes + measure console list latency and weekly egress. I'll own benchmarks.
Maya: Drafting PR with: event shape, sampling rules, RBAC matrix, console mocks. assigning @Sanjay and @Alex for reviews.
Sanjay: I'll handle telemetry estimates and retention scenarios.
Alex: I'll take auth/signing, signed URL TTLs + export signing.
eng-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8123 (audit-breadcrumbs) :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks — will schedule a sync if any blockers. :calendar:
Kira: leaving a docs note: "compact breadcrumbs" and "snapshot export" endpoints + examples.
Maya: filing follow-ups in the PR, marking blockers if any.
